passages.text: Then the angel who was speaking with me returned and woke me, as a man is awakened from his sleep.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke with me.
This angel returned to me.
The angel woke me up.
He woke me up like a man wakes from sleep.
passages.original: וַיָּ֕שָׁב הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיְעִירֵ֕נִי כְּאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵע֥וֹר מִשְּׁנָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: “What do you see?” he asked. “I see a solid gold lampstand,” I replied, “with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven spouts to the lamps.
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He asked, “What do you see?”
I answered him.
I said, “I see a lampstand.”
The lampstand is made of pure gold.
There is a bowl on top of the lampstand.
There are seven lamps on the lampstand.
Each lamp has seven spouts.
The spouts are for the lamps on top of the lampstand.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמֶר רָאִ֣יתִי׀ וְהִנֵּ֣ה מְנוֹרַת֩ זָהָ֨ב כֻּלָּ֜הּ וְגֻלָּ֣הּ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֗הּ וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה נֵרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ שִׁבְעָ֤ה וְשִׁבְעָה֙ מֽוּצָק֔וֹת לַנֵּר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ רֹאשָֽׁהּ׃

passages.text: There are also two olive trees beside it, one on the right side of the bowl and the other on its left.”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision.
He saw a golden lampstand with a bowl on top.
Two olive trees stood beside the lampstand.
One olive tree was on the right side of the bowl.
The other olive tree was on the left side of the bowl.
passages.original: וּשְׁנַ֥יִם זֵיתִ֖ים עָלֶ֑יהָ אֶחָד֙ מִימִ֣ין הַגֻּלָּ֔ה וְאֶחָ֖ד עַל־ שְׂמֹאלָֽהּ׃

passages.text: “What are these, my lord?” I asked the angel who was speaking with me.
passages.sermon: The angel spoke with me.\r\nI answered the angel.\r\nI said, “What are these, my lord?”
passages.original: וָאַ֙עַן֙ וָֽאֹמַ֔ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר מָה־ אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: “Do you not know what they are?” replied the angel. “No, my lord,” I answered.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke with me.
The angel replied to me.
The angel asked me a question.
The angel said, “Do you not know what they are?”
I answered the angel.
I said, “No, my lord.”
passages.original: וַ֠יַּעַן הַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּי֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הֲל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה־ הֵ֣מָּה אֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: So he said to me, “This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He gave me a message from the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Zerubbabel.
The LORD of Hosts said this.
You will not succeed by your own strength.
You will not succeed by your own power.
You will succeed by My Spirit.
The LORD of Hosts has said this.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֚ה דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א בְחַ֙יִל֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹ֔חַ כִּ֣י אִם־ בְּרוּחִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone accompanied by shouts of ‘Grace, grace to it!’ ”
passages.sermon:
Zerubbabel was the leader rebuilding the temple in Jerusalem.
A great mountain stands as an obstacle before Zerubbabel.
The Lord addresses the mountain directly.
The Lord asks, “Who are you, great mountain?”
The Lord declares that the mountain will become a plain before Zerubbabel.
Zerubbabel will bring out the capstone of the temple.
People will shout, “Grace, grace to it!” as Zerubbabel sets the capstone.
passages.original: מִֽי־ אַתָּ֧ה הַֽר־ הַגָּד֛וֹל לִפְנֵ֥י זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לְמִישֹׁ֑ר וְהוֹצִיא֙ אֶת־ הָאֶ֣בֶן הָרֹאשָׁ֔ה תְּשֻׁא֕וֹת חֵ֥ן חֵ֖ן לָֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
God spoke to me.
Zerubbabel is the leader of the people.
Zerubbabel’s hands have laid the foundation of this house.
Zerubbabel’s hands will also finish this house.
You will see this happen.
Then you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent me to you.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ יְדֵ֣י זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יִסְּד֛וּ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה וְיָדָ֣יו תְּבַצַּ֑עְנָה וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD has seven eyes.
These eyes belong to the LORD of Hosts.
The seven eyes watch over the whole earth.
Zerubbabel is the leader rebuilding the temple.
Zerubbabel holds the plumb line in his hand.
The seven eyes of the LORD will rejoice when they see the plumb line in Zerubbabel’s hand.
No one should despise the day of small things.
Small beginnings matter to the LORD.
The LORD sees and values every faithful effort.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י בַז֮ לְי֣וֹם קְטַנּוֹת֒ וְשָׂמְח֗וּ וְרָא֞וּ אֶת־ הָאֶ֧בֶן הַבְּדִ֛יל בְּיַ֥ד זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעָה־ אֵ֑לֶּה עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הֵ֥מָּה מְשׁוֹטְטִ֖ים בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then I asked the angel, “What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand?”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah spoke to the angel.
Zechariah asked a question.
He said, “What are these two olive trees?”
One olive tree stands on the right side of the lampstand.
The other olive tree stands on the left side of the lampstand.
passages.original: וָאַ֖עַן וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלָ֑יו מַה־ שְּׁנֵ֤י הַזֵּיתִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶה עַל־ יְמִ֥ין הַמְּנוֹרָ֖ה וְעַל־ שְׂמֹאולָֽהּ׃

passages.text: And I questioned him further, “What are the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes from which the golden oil pours?”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision from God.
Zechariah spoke to the angel.
Zechariah asked a question.
Zechariah said, “What are the two olive branches?”
The two olive branches stand beside the two gold pipes.
Golden oil pours out from the two gold pipes.
passages.original: וָאַ֣עַן שֵׁנִ֔ית וָאֹמַ֖ר אֵלָ֑יו מַה־ שְׁתֵּ֞י שִׁבֲּלֵ֣י הַזֵּיתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּיַ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ צַנְתְּר֣וֹת הַזָּהָ֔ב הַֽמְרִיקִ֥ים מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃

passages.text: “Do you not know what these are?” he inquired. “No, my lord,” I replied.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to me.
The angel asked me a question.
He said, “Do you know what these are?”
I answered the angel.
I said, “No, my lord.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה־ אֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: So he said, “These are the two anointed ones who are standing beside the Lord of all the earth.”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He explained the vision.
He said, “These are the two anointed ones.”
These two stand beside the Lord.
The Lord rules over all the earth.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ הַיִּצְהָ֑ר הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־ אֲד֥וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
